notes: Extracted through real MCP SDK tools/list using in-memory linked transport and registerAllTools; no business handlers invoked, credentials supplied, or remote services contacted.
Includes 27 WhatsApp Business tools as unrelated to Meta Ads; credential, help, rate-status and Instagram lookup tools marked supporting.

tools.name: ads_create_campaign
tools.description: ⚠️ Modifies live ads/account data. Create a new Meta advertising campaign. Uses outcome-based (ODAX) objectives. Campaigns are created in PAUSED status by default. Budget belongs at exactly one level: pass daily_budget or lifetime_budget here for a campaign budget, or omit both and set budgets on each ad set. For ad-set budgets Meta requires an explicit is_adset_budget_sharing_enabled; this tool sends false unless you pass true.

objective.description: Campaign objective (OUTCOME_AWARENESS, OUTCOME_TRAFFIC, OUTCOME_ENGAGEMENT, OUTCOME_LEADS, OUTCOME_SALES, OUTCOME_APP_PROMOTION)

special_ad_categories.description: Special ad categories (NONE, EMPLOYMENT, HOUSING, CREDIT, FINANCIAL_PRODUCTS_SERVICES, ISSUES_ELECTIONS_POLITICS, ONLINE_GAMBLING_AND_GAMING)

daily_budget.description: Campaign daily budget in the account currency's minor unit as Meta defines it: hundredths for most currencies (USD 5000 = $50.00), whole units for COP, CLP, PYG, CRC, JPY and others (COP 50000 = 50,000 pesos). Check the account currency first (ads_get_account_info). Omit to set budgets on the ad sets instead.

lifetime_budget.description: Campaign lifetime budget, in the same unit as daily_budget. Omit to set budgets on the ad sets instead.

is_adset_budget_sharing_enabled.description: Ad set budget sharing lets Meta move up to 20% of each ad set's daily budget to other ad sets in the same campaign when that is likely to perform better. It only works when the budget lives on the ad sets (Meta rejects it next to a campaign daily_budget or lifetime_budget, error 4834002), only with daily ad set budgets, and every ad set in the campaign must use the same bid strategy (Meta rejects enabling it without one, error 4834005). Meta recommends true. Marketing API v24.0+ requires this whenever the campaign has no budget of its own; when omitted in that case the tool sends false.

tools.name: ads_update_campaign
tools.description: ⚠️ Modifies live ads/account data. Update an existing campaign's name, status, budget, bid strategy, or ad set budget sharing.

daily_budget.description: Daily budget in the account currency's minor unit as Meta defines it: hundredths for most currencies (USD 5000 = $50.00), whole units for COP, CLP, PYG, CRC, JPY and others (COP 50000 = 50,000 pesos). Check the account currency first (ads_get_account_info).

lifetime_budget.description: Lifetime budget, in the same unit as daily_budget.

is_adset_budget_sharing_enabled.description: Ad set budget sharing lets Meta move up to 20% of each ad set's daily budget to other ad sets in the same campaign when that is likely to perform better. It only works when the budget lives on the ad sets (Meta rejects it next to a campaign daily_budget or lifetime_budget, error 4834002), only with daily ad set budgets, and every ad set in the campaign must use the same bid strategy (Meta rejects enabling it without one, error 4834005). Meta recommends true. On an existing campaign Meta only supports turning it off; turning it on for a running campaign is rejected (error 3858418). Omit to keep the current setting.

tools.name: ads_delete_campaign
tools.description: ⚠️ Modifies live ads/account data. Delete a campaign (soft delete — sets status to DELETED). The campaign can still be viewed but will stop serving.

tools.name: ads_get_ad_sets

tools.name: ads_get_ad_set_details
tools.description: Get detailed information about a specific ad set including targeting, budget, and optimization settings.

tools.name: ads_clone_ad_set_bundle
tools.description: ⚠️ Modifies live ads/account data. Clone an ad set bundle in one operation: reads a source ad set, clones its targeting/budget/pixel setup into a new ad set, and recreates every ad by duplicating it with Meta's native ad-copy endpoint (POST /{ad_id}/copies). Native copy gives 100% creative-type coverage — link, image, video, carousel, collection, catalog/Advantage+ catalog, dynamic (asset_feed_spec), and boosted posts all clone losslessly, with the destination ad set's pixel applied automatically. Designed for workflows like duplicating a GEO-specific ad set to another country with a different pixel while keeping every new resource PAUSED by default. creative_overrides change copy per source ad: on standard (object_story_spec) creatives the override is applied by swapping a modified creative onto the copied ad; on dynamic or otherwise non-patchable creatives the override cannot be applied and is reported in warnings while the ad remains in created_ads. If a single ad fails to copy it is reported in skipped and the rest proceed. Supports dry_run planning and idempotency_key-based retry safety. The copied targeting is adapted to the Marketing API version in use before the ad set is created: placements Meta has removed (Facebook video_feeds, Instagram explore, Messenger story) are dropped, and a missing Advantage+ audience setting becomes an explicit opt-out (advantage_audience 0). The clone is refused, before anything is created, when dropping a placement would widen delivery or leave no placements. Every adjustment is listed in warnings, including on dry runs. A creative swapped in by creative_overrides keeps the source creative's destination setting (destination_spec) and WhatsApp Status identity (wamo_whatsapp_identity_spec) when Meta reports them; when it reports none, the new creative sends none and follows Meta's defaults.

source_ad_set_id.description: Source ad set ID to clone

name.description: Name for the cloned ad set

geo_override.description: Geo override that REPLACES the source geo_locations (for example, { countries: ['CL'] }). Cities/regions/zips from the source are NOT inherited.

status.description: Status for the cloned ad set and ads. Defaults to PAUSED.

daily_budget.description: Optional daily budget override in the account currency's minor unit as Meta defines it: hundredths for most currencies (USD 5000 = $50.00), whole units for COP, CLP, PYG, CRC, JPY and others (COP 50000 = 50,000 pesos). Check the account currency first (ads_get_account_info). Takes precedence over the source budget, regardless of source budget type.

lifetime_budget.description: Optional lifetime budget override, in the same unit as daily_budget. Requires end_time.

end_time.description: ISO 8601 end time. Required when lifetime_budget is set.

target_ad_set.description: Configuration for the cloned ad set

creative_overrides.description: Optional creative overrides keyed by source_ad_id or source_creative_id. Applied via creative swap on standard creatives; ignored (and reported) on dynamic or otherwise non-patchable creatives.

dry_run.description: Plan the operation without creating any resources

idempotency_key.description: Required for real execution. Reusing the same key returns the prior result instead of duplicating resources.

tools.name: ads_create_ad_set
tools.description: ⚠️ Modifies live ads/account data. Create a new ad set within a campaign. Requires targeting specification, optimization goal, and destination_type (required for ODAX campaigns). Budget belongs at exactly one level: when the parent campaign has either daily_budget or lifetime_budget (campaign budget / CBO), omit both ad-set budget fields. Only pass daily_budget or lifetime_budget here for ad-set budget / ABO campaigns. Common destination_type values: WEBSITE (traffic/sales to website), APP (app installs), MESSENGER/WHATSAPP/INSTAGRAM_DIRECT (messaging), ON_AD (lead forms, instant experiences). Ad sets are created in PAUSED status by default. When age, gender, custom audiences or detailed targeting are not default and not relaxed, set targeting.targeting_automation.advantage_audience to 1 or 0 explicitly or Meta rejects the ad set.

destination_type.description: Where the ad traffic is directed. Required for ODAX campaigns. Common values: WEBSITE (website traffic/conversions), APP (app installs), MESSENGER (Messenger conversations), WHATSAPP (WhatsApp conversations), INSTAGRAM_DIRECT (Instagram DMs), ON_AD (lead forms, instant experiences, post engagement), ON_VIDEO (video views), ON_PAGE (page engagement), SHOP_AUTOMATIC (shop)

daily_budget.description: Ad-set daily budget in the account currency's minor unit as Meta defines it: hundredths for most currencies (USD 5000 = $50.00), whole units for COP, CLP, PYG, CRC, JPY and others (COP 50000 = 50,000 pesos). Check the account currency first (ads_get_account_info). Omit when the parent campaign has a daily or lifetime budget.

lifetime_budget.description: Ad-set lifetime budget, in the same unit as daily_budget. Omit when the parent campaign has a daily or lifetime budget.

bid_amount.description: Bid cap, in the same unit as daily_budget.

user_os.description: OS targeting: iOS, Android, or versioned like iOS_ver_15.0_and_above

user_device.description: Target specific devices (e.g., Galaxy S24, iPhone 15)

facebook_positions.description: feed, right_hand_column, marketplace, story, search, instream_video, facebook_reels, facebook_reels_overlay, profile_feed, notification. Do not use video_feeds: Meta removed it in Marketing API v24.0 and rejects it (use facebook_reels instead).

instagram_positions.description: stream, story, explore_home, reels, profile_feed, ig_search, profile_reels. Do not use explore: Meta removed the Instagram Explore Feed placement in Marketing API v26.0 and rejects it.

messenger_positions.description: sponsored_messages. Do not use story: Meta removed Messenger Stories in Marketing API v26.0 and silently drops it.

excluded_publisher_list_ids.description: Block list IDs to exclude specific publishers

flexible_spec.description: Array of targeting groups combined with AND; items within each group use OR

advantage_audience.description: 1 to enable Advantage+ audience, 0 to opt out. Meta requires an explicit 1 or 0 when creating an ad set whose age, gender, custom audiences or detailed targeting are not default and not relaxed (Marketing API v23.0+, and v26.0+ for Housing, Employment and Financial Products and Services campaigns). Default or relaxed setups default to 1.

targeting.description: Targeting specification for the ad set

promoted_object.description: Promoted object (e.g., { page_id: '123' } or { pixel_id: '456', custom_event_type: 'PURCHASE' })

tools.name: ads_update_ad_set
tools.description: ⚠️ Modifies live ads/account data. Update an existing ad set in place. Common use cases: change daily_budget or lifetime_budget (unit: see daily_budget), pause/reactivate via status (ACTIVE/PAUSED), extend end_time, replace targeting, adjust bid_amount/bid_strategy, or rename. Only the fields you pass are sent to Meta — omitted fields keep their current value. lifetime_budget requires a corresponding end_time on the ad set. Authentication is handled transparently: the active Meta token is resolved from the request context (Sign in with Meta OAuth, registered System User token, or X-Meta-Token header in service-to-service mode). Note that meaningful changes to bid_amount, bid_strategy, or targeting can re-trigger Meta's learning phase.

status.description: New status. Use ACTIVE to start delivery, PAUSED to stop, ARCHIVED to retire. Use ads_delete_ad_set for soft-deletion.

destination_type.description: Where the ad traffic is directed. Common values: WEBSITE (website traffic/conversions), APP (app installs), MESSENGER (Messenger conversations), WHATSAPP (WhatsApp conversations), INSTAGRAM_DIRECT (Instagram DMs), ON_AD (lead forms, instant experiences, post engagement), ON_VIDEO (video views), ON_PAGE (page engagement), SHOP_AUTOMATIC (shop)

daily_budget.description: Daily budget in the account currency's minor unit as Meta defines it: hundredths for most currencies (USD 5000 = $50.00), whole units for COP, CLP, PYG, CRC, JPY and others (COP 50000 = 50,000 pesos). Check the account currency first (ads_get_account_info). Mutually exclusive with lifetime_budget.

lifetime_budget.description: Lifetime budget, in the same unit as daily_budget. Requires the ad set to have an end_time set; pass end_time in the same call if it isn't already configured.

targeting.description: Replacement targeting spec. Replaces the entire targeting object — pass the full spec, not a partial one.

user_os.description: OS targeting: iOS, Android, or versioned like iOS_ver_15.0_and_above

user_device.description: Target specific devices (e.g., Galaxy S24, iPhone 15)

facebook_positions.description: feed, right_hand_column, marketplace, story, search, instream_video, facebook_reels, facebook_reels_overlay, profile_feed, notification. Do not use video_feeds: Meta removed it in Marketing API v24.0 and rejects it (use facebook_reels instead).

instagram_positions.description: stream, story, explore_home, reels, profile_feed, ig_search, profile_reels. Do not use explore: Meta removed the Instagram Explore Feed placement in Marketing API v26.0 and rejects it.

messenger_positions.description: sponsored_messages. Do not use story: Meta removed Messenger Stories in Marketing API v26.0 and silently drops it.

excluded_publisher_list_ids.description: Block list IDs to exclude specific publishers

flexible_spec.description: Array of targeting groups combined with AND; items within each group use OR

advantage_audience.description: 1 to enable Advantage+ audience, 0 to opt out. Meta requires an explicit 1 or 0 when creating an ad set whose age, gender, custom audiences or detailed targeting are not default and not relaxed (Marketing API v23.0+, and v26.0+ for Housing, Employment and Financial Products and Services campaigns). Default or relaxed setups default to 1.

bid_amount.description: Bid cap, in the same unit as daily_budget. Only meaningful with bid_strategy = LOWEST_COST_WITH_BID_CAP or COST_CAP.

bid_strategy.description: Bidding strategy. Changing strategy may require corresponding changes to bid_amount.

end_time.description: ISO 8601 end time. Required when setting or keeping lifetime_budget.

tools.name: ads_get_ad_details
tools.description: Get detailed information about a specific ad.

tools.name: ads_create_ad
tools.description: ⚠️ Modifies live ads/account data. Create a new ad within an ad set using an existing creative. Ads are created in PAUSED status by default.

ad_set_id.description: Ad set ID to place this ad in

creative_id.description: Creative ID to use for this ad

tools.name: ads_update_ad
tools.description: ⚠️ Modifies live ads/account data. Update an existing ad's name, status, or creative. To change UTM parameters use ads_update_ad_url_tags — url_tags live on the creative, which is immutable.

tools.name: ads_update_ad_url_tags
tools.description: ⚠️ Modifies live ads/account data. Change the UTM parameters (url_tags) of one or more live ads. Meta creatives are immutable, so each ad's creative is cloned with the new url_tags and the ad is repointed at the clone. The clone re-references the source wholesale — the existing Facebook post, the creative spec, or the Instagram post — so media, copy, destination link and CTA are preserved, along with the post's likes and comments. The creative's destination setting (destination_spec, e.g. a Website and Shop opt-out) and WhatsApp Status identity (wamo_whatsapp_identity_spec) are carried over when the creative reports them, because since Marketing API v26.0 a new creative without them defaults to Website and Shop for advertisers with a shop and gets no WhatsApp identity. Side effect: every updated ad re-enters Meta review. Ads whose url_tags already match are skipped, so re-running converges — though an ad whose write failed mid-flight gets its own replacement creative on retry, leaving the earlier one unused (the response reports its id). Do not run two batches over the same ads concurrently. Dynamic creatives (asset_feed_spec) are reported as skipped. Use dry_run to preview.

url_tags.description: New UTM query string, e.g. 'utm_source=meta&utm_medium=paid'. A leading '?' is stripped. Pass an empty string to remove tracking parameters.

dry_run.description: Preview the plan without creating creatives or touching ads

tools.name: ads_delete_ad
tools.description: ⚠️ Modifies live ads/account data. Delete an ad (soft delete — sets status to DELETED).

tools.name: ads_get_ad_creatives
tools.description: Get creative details for an ad or list creatives for an ad account. Returns url_tags (UTM parameters) by default, so a single call can audit tracking across an account.

ad_id.description: Ad ID to get creatives for

account_id.description: Account ID to list all creatives

fields.description: Creative fields to request. 'effective_link_url' is a virtual field derived by this server (never sent to Meta) — requesting it fetches link_url, object_story_spec and asset_feed_spec instead.

tools.name: ads_get_creative_details
tools.description: Get detailed information about a specific creative. 'effective_link_url' is a virtual field this server derives from link_url / object_story_spec / asset_feed_spec — it is accepted in `fields` but never forwarded to Meta.

fields.description: Creative fields to request. 'effective_link_url' is a virtual field derived by this server (never sent to Meta) — requesting it fetches link_url, object_story_spec and asset_feed_spec instead.

tools.name: ads_create_ad_creative
tools.description: ⚠️ Modifies live ads/account data. Create a new ad creative. Three modes: (1) Build from scratch with image/video + text via object_story_spec, (2) Promote an existing Facebook Page post via object_story_id ('Boost Post'), (3) Promote an existing Instagram post via source_instagram_media_id. The creative can then be used when creating ads. Important: scratch-built video creatives require a thumbnail via image_hash or image_url; Meta rejects video_id without one.

page_id.description: Facebook Page ID (required for object_story_spec mode, not needed for object_story_id or source_instagram_media_id)

object_story_id.description: Existing Facebook Page post ID to promote as an ad ('Boost Post' flow). Format: {page_id}_{post_id}. When provided, object_story_spec is NOT built — the existing post is used as-is.

instagram_actor_id.description: Instagram account ID (from ads_get_instagram_account). Required when promoting IG posts.

source_instagram_media_id.description: Instagram media ID to create a creative from an existing IG post (from ads_get_instagram_media). When provided, image_hash/image_url/video_id are ignored.

url_tags.description: Query string params appended to URLs clicked from the ad (e.g. 'utm_source=meta&utm_medium=paid')

tools.name: ads_update_ad_creative
tools.description: ⚠️ Modifies live ads/account data. Update an existing creative's name. Every other creative field (content, links, url_tags) is immutable after creation — to change an ad's UTM parameters use ads_update_ad_url_tags, which clones the creative and repoints the ad.

tools.name: ads_upload_ad_image
tools.description: ⚠️ Modifies live ads/account data. Upload an image to Meta for use in ad creatives. Provide an image URL — the server will download and upload it to Meta. Returns an image hash for use in ads_create_ad_creative.

image_url.description: URL of the image to upload

tools.name: ads_get_ad_images
tools.description: List images uploaded to an ad account with their full URLs. Useful for previewing creative assets without opening Ads Manager.

tools.name: ads_get_ad_videos
tools.description: List videos uploaded to an ad account with source URLs and thumbnails. Use this to preview video creatives directly.

tools.name: ads_get_video_details
tools.description: Get detailed information about a specific video including source URL, thumbnails at different sizes, and processing status.

tools.name: ads_upload_ad_video
tools.description: ⚠️ Modifies live ads/account data. Upload a video to Meta for use in ad creatives. Provide either a public video URL (file_url) or an Instagram media ID (source_instagram_media_id) to upload directly from IG. Returns a video_id for use in ads_create_ad_creative. Useful for promoting Instagram Reels.

file_url.description: Public URL of the video file (MP4). Required unless source_instagram_media_id is provided. Can be an Instagram Reel media_url.

source_instagram_media_id.description: Instagram media ID (V2) to upload an IG video directly to the ad library. Alternative to file_url — simplifies the Reel promotion flow.

name.description: Name of the video in the ad library (for organization). Different from title.

tools.name: ads_get_creative_media
tools.description: Download the actual creative media for an ad or creative and return the images inline for visual analysis. Images (including carousel cards and video thumbnails) come back as image content blocks a multimodal model can see directly. Videos: video_delivery=thumbnail (default) returns the poster frame plus a short-lived signed source URL in the JSON metadata; video_delivery=frames additionally extracts real keyframes with ffmpeg as image blocks so any multimodal model can analyze the video; video_delivery=url returns resource_link blocks. For the MP4 itself (video-capable models such as Gemini) use ads_get_video_media with delivery=inline.

ad_id.description: Ad ID — its creative is resolved automatically

account_id.description: Ad account ID (act_… or numeric). Only needed as a fallback when the creative references image hashes and the account cannot be derived from the ad/creative

image_size.description: full = original CDN image; small = 128px preview (url_128) when available — cheaper on context

max_images.description: Cap on returned image blocks (bounds response/context size)

include_videos.description: Also resolve videos: returns each video's thumbnail as an image block plus its signed source URL in the JSON metadata

video_delivery.description: thumbnail = poster image only (default); frames = also extract keyframes with ffmpeg (grid contact sheet); url = also return signed CDN links as resource_link blocks

tools.name: ads_get_video_media
tools.description: Fetch an ad video so a model can actually analyze it — own-account videos (video_id / ad_id / creative_id) or Meta Ad Library videos (dataset_id + ad_archive_id). delivery=frames (default): the server extracts real keyframes with ffmpeg and returns them as image blocks any multimodal model can see (grid contact sheet by default; frame_layout=individual for one image per frame; include_audio adds an audio/aac block). delivery=inline: embeds the MP4 itself as a resource blob (video/mp4) for clients whose model ingests video natively, e.g. Gemini CLI or agents on the Gemini API — no intermediary needed. Payloads are large: up to 20 MiB per video over HTTP; over stdio this server caps a whole result at 6 MiB of raw media, because clients on the TypeScript MCP SDK close the connection on a message above 10 MiB by default. Use frames for models that read images rather than video. delivery=url: only signed CDN links (short-lived) as resource_link blocks. delivery=thumbnail: poster image only. Returns a text summary, the media blocks, then JSON metadata (duration, dimensions, fps, audio, block indexes, expiry).

ad_id.description: Ad ID — every video in its creative is resolved

dataset_id.description: Apify dataset ID of an Ad Library scrape (pair with ad_archive_id)

hint_offset.description: Offset of the ad inside the dataset, as reported by ads_library_get_results — skips the scan

video_index.description: Pick one video by its position in the resolved list (0-based; e.g. a carousel or DCO card beyond max_videos)

frame_count.description: Frames to sample, evenly spaced (frames mode)

frame_layout.description: grid = one contact sheet (cheapest on context); individual = one image per frame

frame_width.description: Width of individual frames in px

include_audio.description: Also return the audio track as an audio/aac block (frames mode; only useful for audio-capable models)

quality.description: inline mode: compact = 480p/10fps h264 transcode that fits max_inline_bytes; original = embed the CDN file untouched if it fits

max_inline_bytes.description: inline mode size cap in bytes; clamped to 20 MiB over HTTP and 6 MiB over stdio, where MCP SDK clients read through a 10 MiB buffer by default

max_videos.description: Cap on videos processed per call (carousels / asset feeds)

tools.name: ads_analyze_video
tools.description: Have the server watch an ad video with Google Gemini and return a structured analysis: hook, verbatim transcript, on-screen text, scene list, audio, format, branding, compliance flags, strengths, weaknesses and ideas to test. For agents whose own model cannot ingest video. If yours can (Gemini CLI and agents on the Gemini API), ads_get_video_media with delivery=inline embeds the MP4 directly and costs nothing; delivery=frames gives real keyframes to any image-capable model. Needs a Gemini API key registered for your account (ads_register_gemini_key or the /auth/connections page); it is your key and your quota, roughly USD 0.02 per ad. The video is sent to Google for analysis, and one above the inline threshold is uploaded temporarily to the Gemini Files API and deleted right after (Google removes leftovers within 48 hours). Own-account videos (video_id / ad_id / creative_id) and Meta Ad Library videos (dataset_id + ad_archive_id) both work. One video per call: use card_index to pick one from a carousel or DCO ad. Repeats with the same arguments come from a short-lived server cache and are not billed again.

ad_id.description: Ad ID — every video in its creative is resolved

dataset_id.description: Apify dataset ID of an Ad Library scrape (pair with ad_archive_id)

hint_offset.description: Offset of the ad inside the dataset, as reported by ads_library_get_results — skips the scan

video_index.description: Pick one video by its position in the resolved list (0-based; e.g. a carousel or DCO card beyond max_videos)

card_index.description: Which video of the ad to analyze (0-based, in reading order); alias of video_index

focus.description: A specific question to answer, e.g. 'why does retention drop after 3s?' or 'is the offer clear without sound?'

language.description: Language the analysis is written in (BCP-47, e.g. es, en, pt-BR). Transcripts stay in the original language.

detail.description: standard = low media resolution, cheaper and enough for structure; deep = high resolution, better for small on-screen text

quality.description: Which rendition to analyze; sd is faster and cheaper, hd helps when text or products are small

tools.name: ads_get_ad_dossier
tools.description: Everything about one of your own ads in one call: the ad and its status and policy issues, the ad set and campaign it belongs to, the creative with its copy, effective landing URL and UTM tags, the targeting in Meta's own words, the performance insights for the period with the video retention funnel and the auction rankings, and the creative media itself as image blocks (video_delivery=frames adds real keyframes). Built for a creative review or a diagnosis, where asking for each piece separately would cost a dozen calls. Every section is optional and a section that fails is named rather than failing the call.

include_media.description: Attach the creative's images, and its videos through the video pipeline

video_delivery.description: thumbnail = poster only; frames = real keyframes with ffmpeg; url = signed links

image_size.description: full = original CDN image; small = 128px preview, cheaper on context

tools.name: ads_get_ad_entities
tools.description: Generic getter for campaigns, ad sets, or ads under a parent. Use entity_type to choose. parent_id is the ad account ID for campaigns, the campaign ID for ad sets, the ad set ID (or campaign/account) for ads. Mirrors the official Meta MCP vocabulary; equivalent to ads_get_campaigns / ads_get_ad_sets / ads_get_ads.

parent_id.description: Account ID for campaigns, campaign ID for ad_sets, ad_set/campaign/account ID for ads

tools.name: ads_update_entity
tools.description: ⚠️ Modifies live ads/account data. Generic updater for a campaign, ad set, or ad. Pass the changes in 'updates'. Mirrors the official Meta MCP vocabulary; equivalent to ads_update_campaign / ads_update_ad_set / ads_update_ad. Only the fields you pass are sent to Meta — omitted fields keep their current value.

entity_id.description: ID of the entity to update

updates.description: Fields to update (e.g. { name, status, daily_budget }). See entity-specific update tools for valid keys per type. Complex fields (targeting, creative, evaluation_spec) are JSON-encoded automatically. daily_budget, lifetime_budget and bid_amount are in the account currency's minor unit as Meta defines it: hundredths for most currencies (USD 5000 = $50.00), whole units for COP, CLP, PYG, CRC, JPY and others (COP 50000 = 50,000 pesos). Check the account currency first (ads_get_account_info).

tools.name: ads_activate_entity
tools.description: ⚠️ Modifies live ads/account data. Toggle the status of a campaign, ad set, or ad. Use status='ACTIVE' to start delivery, 'PAUSED' to stop, 'ARCHIVED' to retire. For deletion use ads_delete_campaign / ads_delete_ad_set / ads_delete_ad. Mirrors the official Meta MCP vocabulary.

tools.name: ads_get_insights
tools.description: Get performance insights (metrics) for a campaign, ad set, ad, or account. Supports breakdowns, date ranges, attribution windows, and time series. Unsafe combos (account-level + high-cardinality breakdowns, wide date ranges + breakdowns in sync) are rejected early — use ads_run_report_and_wait for those. Recommended: pass filtering=[{field:"ad.impressions",operator:"GREATER_THAN",value:0}] to skip objects without data.

object_id.description: Campaign, Ad Set, Ad, or Account ID (use act_XXX for accounts)

level.description: Aggregation level — useful when querying account/campaign to break down to ad set or ad level

time_range.description: Custom date range (prefer date_preset when one matches — it's more efficient server-side)

date_preset.description: Predefined date range (preferred over time_range for stability and performance)

breakdowns.description: Breakdown dimensions. Avoid product_id / asset-level on account-wide queries.

fields.description: Metrics to retrieve (defaults to standard set)

use_unified_attribution_setting.description: Default true: match Ads Manager behaviour (Meta change effective 2025-06-10). Set false only for bespoke attribution.

filtering.description: Server-side filter, e.g. [{field:"ad.impressions",operator:"GREATER_THAN",value:0}] to skip empty objects.

time_increment.description: Time increment for series data — number of days, 'monthly', or 'all_days'

tools.name: ads_insights_performance_trend
tools.description: Time-series view of core KPIs (spend, impressions, CTR, CPC, conversions) for an account, campaign, ad set, or ad. Choose granularity to bucket the series by day/week/month. Mirrors the official Meta MCP view.

object_id.description: Account, campaign, ad set, or ad ID

tools.name: ads_insights_anomaly_signal
tools.description: Detect anomalies by comparing the last N days against the previous N days. Returns metrics whose change exceeds threshold_pct. Useful for `why is spend up?` / `did CPL spike?` workflows.

object_id.description: Account, campaign, ad set, or ad ID

tools.name: ads_insights_auction_ranking_benchmarks
tools.description: Quality, engagement, and conversion rate rankings for an ad in Meta's auction. Only available at level=ad with sufficient delivery (~500 impressions). Useful to diagnose 'below average' creatives that compete poorly.

ad_id.description: Ad ID (rankings are only published at ad level)

tools.name: ads_insights_industry_benchmark
tools.description: Compare an object's CTR / CPC / CPM against industry medians (when available). For now uses a curated benchmark table; falls back to portfolio averages if industry not specified. Best-effort signal — Meta does not expose an authoritative benchmark API.

object_id.description: Account, campaign, ad set, or ad ID

tools.name: ads_insights_advertiser_context
tools.description: First-message account snapshot for an agent: account-level KPIs, top campaigns by spend, and key totals over a date range. Use this when starting an analysis session before drilling into specific campaigns.

tools.name: ads_search_interests
tools.description: Search for interest targeting options by keyword. Returns matching interests with audience sizes.

tools.name: ads_get_interest_suggestions
tools.description: Get interest suggestions based on existing interests. Useful for expanding targeting.

interest_list.description: List of interest names to get suggestions for

tools.name: ads_search_behaviors
tools.description: Get behavior targeting options. Behaviors include purchase behavior, device usage, travel, etc.

tools.name: ads_search_demographics
tools.description: Get demographic targeting options by category (e.g., income, family status, education, life events, industries).

tools.name: ads_search_geo_locations
tools.description: Search for geographic targeting locations (countries, regions, cities, zip codes, etc.).

tools.name: ads_estimate_audience_size
tools.description: Estimate the audience size for a targeting specification. Useful for validating targeting before creating ad sets.

targeting_spec.description: Targeting specification (same format as ads_create_ad_set targeting)

tools.name: ads_get_targeting_description
tools.description: Get a human-readable description of an ad's targeting specification. Can also preview what a targeting_spec would describe before creating an ad set.

ad_id.description: Ad ID to get targeting description for

account_id.description: Ad account ID (required when using targeting_spec)

targeting_spec.description: Targeting spec to preview (same format as ads_create_ad_set targeting). Requires account_id.

tools.name: ads_create_budget_schedule
tools.description: ⚠️ Modifies live ads/account data. Schedule a temporary budget increase for a campaign during high-demand periods (e.g., Black Friday, product launches).

budget_value.description: For ABSOLUTE, a budget amount in the account currency's minor unit as Meta defines it: hundredths for most currencies (USD 5000 = $50.00), whole units for COP, CLP, PYG, CRC, JPY and others (COP 50000 = 50,000 pesos). Check the account currency first (ads_get_account_info). For MULTIPLIER, the multiplier value.

budget_value_type.description: ABSOLUTE = set exact budget (unit: see budget_value), MULTIPLIER = multiply current budget

time_start.description: ISO 8601 start time for the budget increase

time_end.description: ISO 8601 end time for the budget increase

tools.name: ads_get_lead_forms
tools.description: List lead generation forms for a Facebook Page. Returns form details including questions, status, and lead count.

tools.name: ads_get_leads
tools.description: Download leads from a lead generation form. Returns lead data including field values, timestamps, and associated ad/campaign info.

tools.name: ads_get_ad_leads
tools.description: Get leads generated by a specific ad. Useful for analyzing lead quality per ad variant.

tools.name: ads_create_lead_form
tools.description: ⚠️ Modifies live ads/account data. Create a new lead generation form for a Facebook Page.

type.description: Question type (e.g., FULL_NAME, EMAIL, PHONE_NUMBER, CUSTOM)

tools.name: ads_get_custom_audiences
tools.description: List custom audiences for an ad account. Includes lookalikes, website audiences, customer lists, engagement audiences and offline-conversion audiences. Use the returned audience id with ads_update_ad_set (targeting.custom_audiences=[{id}]) to apply the audience to an ad set.

tools.name: ads_get_audience_details
tools.description: Get detailed information about a specific custom audience, including subtype, retention period, approximate size bounds and lookalike spec. Useful before applying it to an ad set via ads_update_ad_set.

tools.name: ads_create_custom_audience
tools.description: ⚠️ Modifies live ads/account data. Create a custom audience on an ad account. Two main flows: (a) WEBSITE pixel-based — pass 'rule' (event_sources of type 'pixel') and OMIT 'subtype' (Meta v18+ infers it; passing subtype: WEBSITE returns error 2654). (b) CUSTOM customer-list — pass subtype: 'CUSTOM' + customer_file_source; PII must be SHA-256 hashed before uploading users. After creation: build a lookalike with ads_create_lookalike_audience and apply the id to an ad set with ads_update_ad_set (targeting.custom_audiences=[{id}]).

subtype.description: Audience subtype. OMIT (or pass 'WEBSITE') when 'rule' is set — for pixel-based audiences Meta infers the subtype and rejects an explicit one (error 2654); the tool drops it automatically. For non-rule flows: when omitted, defaults to 'CUSTOM' (customer-list), which also requires customer_file_source.

rule.description: JSON rule for pixel/event-based audiences (WEBSITE). Shape: {inclusions:{operator:'or',rules:[{event_sources:[{id:'<pixel_id>',type:'pixel'}],retention_seconds:<n>,filter:{operator:'and',filters:[{field:'event',operator:'=',value:'<event_name>'}]}}]}}. When 'rule' is set, omit 'subtype'.

prefill.description: Whether to prefill with existing data (for WEBSITE)

tools.name: ads_create_lookalike_audience
tools.description: ⚠️ Modifies live ads/account data. Create a lookalike audience seeded by an existing custom audience. Source must have ~100+ matched users or Meta rejects the request. Ratio controls similarity vs. reach (0.01 = closest 1%, 0.20 = top 20% — bigger reach, lower similarity). After creation, apply the lookalike id to an ad set with ads_update_ad_set (targeting.custom_audiences=[{id}]). Lookalikes typically need ~24 h to compute users — id is returned immediately but reach starts at zero.

country.description: Target country ISO code (e.g., CO, US, MX)

tools.name: ads_share_custom_audience
tools.description: ⚠️ Modifies live ads/account data. Share a custom audience with one or more ad accounts under the same Business Manager. Both source and target accounts must belong to the same BM and the caller needs ads_management on each. Shareable subtypes: CUSTOM, LOOKALIKE, WEBSITE (engagement/offline-conversion audiences cannot be shared — Meta returns code 2655). Re-sharing with the same account is a no-op. After sharing, the target account can target the audience via ads_update_ad_set (targeting.custom_audiences=[{id}]).

ad_account_ids.description: Target ad account IDs (numeric or act_<id>). Must be in the same Business Manager as the audience owner.

tools.name: ads_unshare_custom_audience
tools.description: ⚠️ Modifies live ads/account data. Revoke a custom audience share from one or more ad accounts. Only removes the share relationship — the audience itself remains on the owner account. Use ads_get_audience_shared_accounts first to confirm which accounts currently have access.

ad_account_ids.description: Ad account IDs to revoke (numeric or act_<id>).

tools.name: ads_get_audience_shared_accounts
tools.description: List ad accounts that currently have shared access to a custom audience. Returns each account id + name. Use before ads_share_custom_audience / ads_unshare_custom_audience to audit the share set.

tools.name: ads_delete_custom_audience
tools.description: ⚠️ Modifies live ads/account data. Permanently delete a custom audience from the ad account. Cannot be undone. To remove an audience from a single ad set without destroying it everywhere, prefer ads_update_ad_set with targeting.custom_audiences set to a different array (or omitted from a fresh targeting spec).

tools.name: ads_get_ad_preview
tools.description: Generate a preview of an existing ad in a specific placement format (feed, stories, reels, etc.). Returns HTML preview and shareable link.

tools.name: ads_generate_preview
tools.description: Generate a preview from a creative specification without creating an actual ad. Useful for previewing creative concepts before launch.

tools.name: ads_get_pixels
tools.description: List pixels for an ad account. Returns pixel IDs, names, and last fire times.

tools.name: ads_get_pixel_details
tools.description: Get detailed information about a specific pixel including its installation code snippet.

tools.name: ads_get_pixel_events
tools.description: Get event statistics for a pixel. Useful for debugging tracking issues — shows which events are being received and their counts.

tools.name: ads_get_custom_conversions
tools.description: List custom conversions for an ad account.

tools.name: ads_create_custom_conversion
tools.description: ⚠️ Modifies live ads/account data. Create a custom conversion for an ad account. Define rules based on URL or pixel events.

rule.description: Conversion rule (JSON string, e.g., URL contains, event parameters)

tools.name: ads_get_ad_comments
tools.description: List comments on an ad post. Uses the ad's effective_object_story_id to fetch comments. Important for compliance monitoring in regulated industries.

ad_id.description: Ad ID — will resolve to the post automatically

filter.description: Filter: toplevel (only direct comments) or stream (all including replies)

tools.name: ads_hide_comment
tools.description: ⚠️ Modifies live ads/account data. Hide or unhide a comment on an ad post. Hidden comments are only visible to the commenter and their friends.

is_hidden.description: true to hide, false to unhide

tools.name: ads_reply_comment
tools.description: ⚠️ Modifies live ads/account data. Reply to a comment on an ad post. The reply will appear as a nested comment. Re-running creates duplicate replies — not idempotent.

tools.name: ads_delete_comment
tools.description: ⚠️ Modifies live ads/account data. Delete a comment on an ad post. This action cannot be undone.

tools.name: ads_get_ad_rules
tools.description: List automated rules for an ad account. Shows rules that auto-pause, adjust budgets, or send notifications based on performance.

tools.name: ads_create_ad_rule
tools.description: ⚠️ Modifies live ads/account data. Create an automated rule. Examples: pause adsets when CPL > $20, notify when CTR < 1%, increase budget when ROAS > 3x.

evaluation_type.description: TRIGGER for real-time, SCHEDULE for periodic

execution_type.description: Action to take when conditions are met

tools.name: ads_get_rule_details
tools.description: Get detailed information about an automated rule and its execution history.

tools.name: ads_update_ad_rule
tools.description: ⚠️ Modifies live ads/account data. Update an existing automated rule's name, status, or specs.

tools.name: ads_delete_ad_rule
tools.description: ⚠️ Modifies live ads/account data. Delete an automated rule.

tools.name: ads_get_ad_studies
tools.description: List A/B test studies (split tests) for an ad account.

tools.name: ads_create_ad_study
tools.description: ⚠️ Modifies live ads/account data. Create an A/B test (split test) to compare ad variations with statistical significance. Supports testing creative, audience, placement, and delivery optimization variables.

ad_sets.description: Ad set IDs for this cell

cells.description: Test cells/variants — each gets a portion of the traffic

tools.name: ads_get_study_details
tools.description: Get detailed information and results of an A/B test study, including per-cell performance and statistical significance.

tools.name: ads_create_async_report
tools.description: ⚠️ Modifies live ads/account data. Create an asynchronous report for large data exports. Use this when you need to pull extensive insights data that would time out with a synchronous request. NOTE: report_run_id expires 30 days after creation. Consider ads_run_report_and_wait for small/medium reports that finish in <10 min.

object_id.description: Campaign, Ad Set, Ad, or Account ID (use act_XXX for accounts)

tools.name: ads_get_report_status
tools.description: Check the status of an asynchronous report. Enforces a 5-second minimum between polls for the same report to avoid burning quota. Returns clear guidance on Job Failed / Job Skipped states.

tools.name: ads_get_report_results
tools.description: Download the results of a completed async report.

tools.name: ads_run_report_and_wait
tools.description: ⚠️ Modifies live ads/account data. Create an async report and wait for completion in one call. Uses safe polling (start 10s, backoff to 60s max) and returns results directly when Job Completed. On timeout, returns the report_run_id so you can continue polling later. Max wait: 3600s.

tools.name: ads_get_billing_info
tools.description: Get billing and payment information for an ad account, including funding source, account status, and spend data.

tools.name: ads_get_spend_limit
tools.description: Get spending limits and current spend for an ad account. Shows spend cap, amount spent, daily limits, and remaining balance.

tools.name: ads_update_spend_cap
tools.description: ⚠️ Modifies live ads/account data. Set or remove the spend cap of an ad account: the total it may spend before delivery stops. The cap is written in the account currency's standard unit, with decimals where the currency has them: 500 = USD 500.00, 50000 = COP 50,000. This is NOT the minor unit used for daily_budget and the other budgets, where USD 500.00 is 50000. Setting a cap restarts the account's amount-spent counter. 0 removes the cap. The result reports the cap and the amount spent that Meta holds afterwards.

spend_cap.description: New spend cap in the account currency's standard unit (500 = USD 500.00, 50000 = COP 50,000), not the minor unit used for budgets. 0 removes the cap.

tools.name: ads_get_invoices
tools.description: Get invoices for a business (Meta's business_invoices), with their PDF download links. Provide business_id directly, or account_id to resolve its business automatically. Optionally filter by date range, invoice_id, or type. Note: Meta only exposes invoices for businesses on a credit line / monthly invoicing, and the access token needs the FINANCE_EDITOR or FINANCE_ANALYST role; card-billed accounts have no API invoices.

business_id.description: Business ID. Either this or account_id is required.

account_id.description: Ad account ID. Used to resolve the owning business when business_id is not given.

end_date.description: Filter invoices up to this date (YYYY-MM-DD).

invoice_id.description: Return a single invoice by its invoice_id.

type.description: Invoice type: CM (credit memo), DM (debit memo), INV (invoice), PRO_FORMA.

limit.description: Maximum number of invoices to return.

tools.name: ads_rate_status
tools.description: Show the current Meta API rate-limit usage across tokens, accounts, and use-case types, plus any open circuits and the write-pacer state. Does NOT call Meta — returns in-process state.

tools.name: ads_get_opportunity_score
tools.description: Get Meta's Opportunity Score for an account or campaign — a 0-100 health/improvement signal Meta surfaces in Ads Manager. Includes recommendations when available. Mirrors the official Meta MCP tool.

object_id.description: Required when level='campaign' — the campaign ID to score

tools.name: ads_get_dataset_quality
tools.description: Synthetic health overview for a pixel/dataset: last fire time, match rate, automatic matching configuration. For raw event stats use ads_get_pixel_events; for installation code use ads_get_pixel_details.

tools.name: ads_get_errors
tools.description: List current errors and issues at the account level: rejected ads, ads with delivery issues, account restrictions. Combine with ads_get_help_article to look up rejection reasons. Mirrors the official Meta MCP tool.

tools.name: ads_get_help_article
tools.description: Search Meta Business Help Center articles by query. Returns curated articles relevant to common workflows: rejections, pixel/CAPI setup, audience requirements, billing, learning phase, ad rankings, etc. Mirrors the official Meta MCP tool. Backed by a curated dataset, not a live API — for the most current article, follow the returned URL.

query.description: Search query (e.g., 'why was my ad rejected', 'pixel setup', 'lookalike requirements')

tools.name: ads_diagnose_underperformance
tools.description: Run a compound diagnostic on an underperforming object: anomaly detection vs prior period, auction rankings (when applicable), pixel signal quality (when a pixel is associated), and active errors/issues. Returns a unified report with hypothesis. Agency-tier diagnostic — combines work that the official Meta MCP requires multiple tool calls to do.

object_id.description: Account, campaign, ad set, or ad ID

pixel_id.description: Optional pixel ID to include signal-quality diagnostics

tools.name: ads_portfolio_summary
tools.description: Cross-account aggregation: spend, impressions, clicks, CTR, CPC across N ad accounts in parallel. Agency-tier tool — the official Meta MCP cannot do this because it operates one-user/one-account at a time. Use to get a portfolio-level snapshot for the current period.

account_ids.description: Up to 20 ad account IDs to aggregate

tools.name: ads_bulk_create_video_ads
tools.description: ⚠️ Modifies live ads/account data. Turn a list of public video URLs into ads in one call: uploads each video, waits for Meta to finish processing, auto-selects a thumbnail, builds the creative, and creates the ad in the given ad set. Ads are created PAUSED by default. Per-video copy overrides the shared defaults. A video rejected by Meta does not abort the rest — every item reports its own outcome and the stage it failed at — but an expired token, rate limit or abuse signal stops the batch immediately, as does the same failure repeating (which means a shared input like page_id or ad_set_id is wrong). The whole call is capped at 180s so it always returns the IDs it created; videos left unprocessed come back marked "skipped", and re-running with only those is safe. Use this instead of chaining ads_upload_ad_video → ads_create_ad_creative → ads_create_ad manually.

ad_set_id.description: Ad set ID that will hold the new ads

page_id.description: Facebook Page ID used as the ad's identity

instagram_actor_id.description: Instagram account ID for IG placements (from ads_get_instagram_account)

file_url.description: Public https URL of the video file (MP4/MOV)

ad_name.description: Name of the resulting ad. Defaults to the video name, then to 'Video ad N'.

video_name.description: Name of the video in the ad account library

message.description: Primary text. Overrides the shared message.

description.description: Description below the headline. Overrides the shared description.

link_url.description: Destination URL. Overrides the shared link_url.

call_to_action_type.description: CTA button. Overrides the shared call_to_action_type.

videos.description: Videos to turn into ads (max 20 per call)

message.description: Shared primary text applied to every video without its own message

headline.description: Shared headline applied to every video without its own headline

description.description: Shared description applied to every video without its own description

link_url.description: Shared destination URL applied to every video without its own link_url

call_to_action_type.description: Shared CTA button applied to every video without its own CTA

url_tags.description: Query params appended to clicked URLs (e.g. 'utm_source=meta&utm_medium=paid')

status.description: Status of the created ads. PAUSED by default so nothing starts spending unreviewed.

max_wait_seconds.description: Per-video cap on waiting for Meta to finish processing. Also bounded by the batch-wide time budget.

tools.name: ads_get_instagram_account
tools.description: Get the Instagram Business account linked to a Facebook Page. Returns the Instagram account ID needed for creating ad creatives with Instagram placement.

page_id.description: Facebook Page ID to look up its linked Instagram Business account

tools.name: ads_get_instagram_media
tools.description: List recent media posts from an Instagram Business account. Returns media IDs that can be used with source_instagram_media_id in create_ad_creative to promote existing posts.

tools.name: whatsapp_get_business_accounts
tools.description: List WhatsApp Business Accounts (WABAs) owned by or shared with a business, or get details for one WABA. Without business_id, discovers WABAs across the businesses the token can access. Use this first to find the waba_id required by the other whatsapp_* tools. If Meta returns a permission error (code 200/10), the access token was issued without the whatsapp_business_management scope — re-authorize via the OAuth flow to grant WhatsApp permissions.

business_id.description: Business ID to list WABAs for. Omit to scan all accessible businesses.

waba_id.description: WhatsApp Business Account ID. Provide to fetch details for a single WABA.

include_client_wabas.description: Also list WABAs shared with the business by clients (client_whatsapp_business_accounts).

tools.name: whatsapp_get_phone_numbers
tools.description: List phone numbers registered on a WhatsApp Business Account, or get details for a single phone number. Shows verification status, quality rating, and messaging throughput.

waba_id.description: WhatsApp Business Account ID to list phone numbers for.

phone_number_id.description: Phone number ID for single-number details.

fields.description: Fields to return per phone number.

tools.name: whatsapp_register_phone
tools.description: ⚠️ Modifies live WhatsApp Business data. Register a phone number for use with the WhatsApp Cloud API. Requires the number's 6-digit two-step verification PIN. If the PIN is rejected, the number already has two-step verification enabled with a different PIN — do not retry with guesses.

data_localization_region.description: Optional 2-letter country code for local storage of messages (e.g. 'BR', 'IN').

tools.name: whatsapp_deregister_phone
tools.description: ⚠️ Modifies live WhatsApp Business data. Deregister a phone number from the WhatsApp Cloud API. Reversible: the number stays on the WABA and can be re-registered with whatsapp_register_phone.

tools.name: whatsapp_request_verification_code
tools.description: ⚠️ Modifies live WhatsApp Business data. Request an ownership verification code for a not-yet-verified phone number, delivered via SMS or voice call. Each call sends a new code. Only applies to numbers whose code_verification_status is not VERIFIED.

language.description: Locale for the code message (e.g. en_US, es_ES).

tools.name: whatsapp_verify_code
tools.description: ⚠️ Modifies live WhatsApp Business data. Submit the verification code received via whatsapp_request_verification_code to complete phone number ownership verification.

code.description: Verification code received via SMS or voice.

tools.name: whatsapp_get_business_profile
tools.description: Get the WhatsApp business profile shown to customers for a phone number: about text, address, description, email, websites, vertical, and profile picture URL.

tools.name: whatsapp_update_business_profile
tools.description: ⚠️ Modifies live WhatsApp Business data. Update the WhatsApp business profile for a phone number. Only provided fields are changed. Profile picture updates are not supported here (they require a resumable media upload).

tools.name: whatsapp_get_templates
tools.description: List message templates on a WhatsApp Business Account (filterable by name, status, category, language), or get full details (including components) for a single template by ID.

waba_id.description: WhatsApp Business Account ID to list templates for.

language.description: Filter by language code (e.g. en_US, es_MX).

tools.name: whatsapp_create_template
tools.description: ⚠️ Modifies live WhatsApp Business data. Create a message template on a WhatsApp Business Account. The template enters Meta's review queue (status PENDING). Name must be lowercase letters, digits and underscores. AUTHENTICATION templates only accept OTP-style components. Meta may recategorize the template unless allow_category_change is false.

items.description: Template component object (type HEADER/BODY/FOOTER/BUTTONS plus its fields).

components.description: Template components array, e.g. [{"type":"BODY","text":"Hi {{1}}"},{"type":"FOOTER","text":"Reply STOP to opt out"}].

allow_category_change.description: Let Meta recategorize automatically instead of rejecting on category mismatch.

tools.name: whatsapp_update_template
tools.description: ⚠️ Modifies live WhatsApp Business data. Edit a message template's components, category, or message TTL. Only templates in APPROVED, REJECTED, or PAUSED status can be edited. APPROVED templates can be edited at most once per 24 hours and 10 times per month; editing re-triggers review (status returns to PENDING). Do NOT retry on an edit-limit error.

items.description: Template component object (type HEADER/BODY/FOOTER/BUTTONS plus its fields).

message_send_ttl_seconds.description: Custom time-to-live for sent messages, in seconds.

tools.name: whatsapp_delete_template
tools.description: ⚠️ Modifies live WhatsApp Business data. Delete a message template by name. Without hsm_id, ALL language versions of that name are deleted. Deleted template names cannot be reused for ~4 weeks (pending deletion). Cannot be undone.

hsm_id.description: Specific template ID to delete only one language version instead of all.

tools.name: whatsapp_get_analytics
tools.description: Get WhatsApp Business Account analytics: MESSAGING (messages sent/delivered), CONVERSATION (legacy conversation counts and cost), or PRICING (per-message pricing analytics, current model since July 2025).

start.description: Start of range: YYYY-MM-DD or UNIX seconds.

end.description: End of range: YYYY-MM-DD or UNIX seconds.

granularity.description: Aggregation granularity (mapped automatically per metric family).

dimensions.description: Breakdown dimensions for CONVERSATION/PRICING, e.g. CONVERSATION_CATEGORY, PRICING_CATEGORY, COUNTRY, PHONE.

phone_numbers.description: Filter to specific phone numbers (display format, e.g. +16505551111).

tools.name: whatsapp_get_template_analytics
tools.description: Get per-template performance analytics (sent, delivered, read, clicked) for up to 10 templates. Window must be within the last 90 days; granularity is always DAILY. Requires template analytics to be enabled on the WABA (is_enabled_for_insights) — if Meta returns an error saying it is disabled, report it to the user instead of enabling it (enabling is irreversible).

start.description: Start of range: YYYY-MM-DD or UNIX seconds (max 90 days back).

end.description: End of range: YYYY-MM-DD or UNIX seconds.

metric_types.description: Metrics to include. Defaults to all.

tools.name: whatsapp_get_flows
tools.description: List WhatsApp Flows on a WhatsApp Business Account, or get full details for one flow (including validation errors and a web preview URL).

waba_id.description: WhatsApp Business Account ID to list flows for.

tools.name: whatsapp_create_flow
tools.description: ⚠️ Modifies live WhatsApp Business data. Create a WhatsApp Flow (draft). Optionally provide flow_json to set the flow content in the same call, clone_flow_id to copy an existing flow, or publish=true to publish immediately (only works if the flow has no validation errors).

flow_json.description: Stringified Flow JSON defining the screens and logic.

clone_flow_id.description: Existing flow ID to clone content from.

endpoint_uri.description: Data endpoint URL for dynamic flows (Flow JSON 3.0+).

publish.description: Publish immediately after creation (requires valid flow_json).

tools.name: whatsapp_update_flow
tools.description: ⚠️ Modifies live WhatsApp Business data. Update a flow's metadata (name, categories, endpoint) and/or replace its Flow JSON content. Content updates only apply to DRAFT flows — published flows must be cloned first. Always check validation_errors in the response before publishing.

flow_json.description: Stringified Flow JSON to replace the flow content.

tools.name: whatsapp_publish_flow
tools.description: ⚠️ Modifies live WhatsApp Business data. Publish a DRAFT flow so it can be sent to users. Fails if the flow has validation errors (check with whatsapp_get_flows first). Published flows cannot be edited — only cloned or deprecated.

tools.name: whatsapp_deprecate_flow
tools.description: ⚠️ Modifies live WhatsApp Business data. Deprecate a PUBLISHED flow. IRREVERSIBLE — a deprecated flow can never be reactivated; users who open it see an error. Only use when the flow is retired for good.

tools.name: whatsapp_delete_flow
tools.description: ⚠️ Modifies live WhatsApp Business data. Delete a flow. Only DRAFT flows can be deleted — published flows must be deprecated instead. Cannot be undone.

flow_id.description: Flow ID to delete (must be in DRAFT status).

tools.name: whatsapp_get_qr_codes
tools.description: List QR code deep links for a WhatsApp phone number, or get one by its code. Each QR code opens a chat with a prefilled message when scanned.

code.description: Specific QR code id to fetch.

tools.name: whatsapp_create_qr_code
tools.description: ⚠️ Modifies live WhatsApp Business data. Create a QR code deep link for a WhatsApp phone number. Scanning it opens a chat with the prefilled message. Returns the code, wa.me deep link, and optionally a QR image URL.

prefilled_message.description: Message prefilled in the user's chat when they scan the code.

generate_qr_image.description: Also return a rendered QR image in this format.

tools.name: whatsapp_update_qr_code
tools.description: ⚠️ Modifies live WhatsApp Business data. Update the prefilled message of an existing QR code deep link. The code and deep link URL stay the same.

tools.name: whatsapp_delete_qr_code
tools.description: ⚠️ Modifies live WhatsApp Business data. Delete a QR code deep link. Scans of the printed code stop working. Cannot be undone.

tools.name: whatsapp_get_webhook_subscriptions
tools.description: List the apps subscribed to webhook events on a WhatsApp Business Account, including any callback URI override.

tools.name: whatsapp_subscribe_webhook
tools.description: ⚠️ Modifies live WhatsApp Business data. Subscribe the Meta app that owns this access token to webhook events on a WABA (messages, template status updates, etc.). Events are delivered to the app's configured webhook endpoint — this server does not receive them. Optionally override the callback URL for this WABA (override_callback_uri and verify_token must be provided together).

override_callback_uri.description: Alternate callback URL for this WABA only (requires verify_token).

verify_token.description: Verify token Meta will send to the override callback (required with override_callback_uri).

tools.name: whatsapp_unsubscribe_webhook
tools.description: ⚠️ Modifies live WhatsApp Business data. Unsubscribe the Meta app that owns this access token from webhook events on a WABA. The app stops receiving message and template events for this account.

tools.name: ads_library_register_apify_token
tools.description: ⚠️ Uses your Apify account (paid credits / stored credentials). Register your Apify API token so the ads_library_* tools can scrape the public Meta Ad Library. The token is validated against the Apify API and then stored encrypted (AES-256-GCM) and scoped to your account. Get a token at console.apify.com/settings/integrations. Most users register it on the server's /auth/connections page instead of calling this tool.

tools.name: ads_library_get_apify_token_status
tools.description: Check whether an Apify token is available for the current user, where it comes from (encrypted per-user storage or the APIFY_TOKEN environment fallback), and optionally verify it is still valid against the Apify API.

verify.description: Also call the Apify API to confirm the token still works

tools.name: ads_library_delete_apify_token
tools.description: ⚠️ Uses your Apify account (paid credits / stored credentials). Delete the Apify token stored for the current user. Does not affect the APIFY_TOKEN environment fallback, if one is configured.

tools.name: ads_library_scrape
tools.description: ⚠️ Uses your Apify account (paid credits / stored credentials). Start an asynchronous scrape of the public Meta Ad Library (competitor ad research) via the curious_coder/facebook-ads-library-scraper Apify actor. Costs about $0.75 per 1,000 ads; a hard spend cap derived from "count" is sent to Apify so a run can never bill beyond it. Returns a run_id and dataset_id — poll ads_library_get_run_status, then read ads_library_get_results.

query.description: Keyword to search in the Ad Library. Mutually exclusive with 'url'.

url.description: An https://www.facebook.com Ad Library search URL or a Facebook page URL to scrape ads from. Mutually exclusive with 'query'.

country.description: Uppercase ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code (e.g. CO, US), or ALL

active_status.description: Filter by whether the ad is currently running

ad_type.description: Ad Library category filter (applies to keyword searches)

search_type.description: Whether the keyword must match as an exact phrase

period.description: Date range filter. Only applies when scraping a Facebook page URL. Omit for no date filter.

sort_by.description: Result ordering. Only applies when scraping a Facebook page URL.

count.description: Maximum ads to scrape (1-2000). Drives the spend cap: roughly $0.75 per 1,000 ads.

scrape_ad_details.description: Also fetch per-ad detail such as EU reach/transparency data. Slower.

tools.name: ads_library_get_run_status
tools.description: Check the status of an Ad Library scrape started with ads_library_scrape. Returns the run state, elapsed runtime, accrued cost, and the dataset id to read results from.

tools.name: ads_library_get_results
tools.description: Read scraped ads from a completed Ad Library run's dataset. Returns a compact projection of each ad (page, copy, CTA, dates, platforms, spend) by default; pass raw=true for every field the actor produced.

dataset_id.description: Dataset id from ads_library_scrape or ads_library_get_run_status

raw.description: Return the actor's full untrimmed records instead of the compact projection

tools.name: ads_library_abort_run
tools.description: ⚠️ Uses your Apify account (paid credits / stored credentials). Abort a running Ad Library scrape to stop it accruing cost. Ads already written to the dataset remain readable with ads_library_get_results.

tools.name: ads_library_list_runs
tools.description: List recent Ad Library scrape runs for the current Apify account, newest first. Useful for recovering a run_id or dataset_id, and for reviewing what each run cost.

tools.name: ads_library_get_ad_details
tools.description: Everything about one scraped Ad Library ad, with its media: page, dates, platforms, spend/impressions when Meta exposes them, the full copy (per card for carousels; DCO/DPA template copy is flagged and the real creative comes from the cards), links, EU/UK transparency blocks when scraped, and the images attached as inline image blocks. video_delivery=thumbnail (default) attaches each video poster and returns the signed CDN URLs with their expiry; frames extracts real keyframes with ffmpeg; url returns resource_link blocks. For the MP4 itself (video-capable models such as Gemini) call ads_get_video_media with dataset_id + ad_archive_id and delivery=inline. Pass hint_offset from ads_library_get_results to skip the dataset scan. Reading a dataset is free on Apify.

hint_offset.description: Absolute offset of the ad in the dataset (from ads_library_get_results); avoids scanning

include_images.description: Attach the ad images (and image cards) as inline image blocks

image_size.description: full = original CDN image; small = 600px resized copy (cheaper on context)

video_delivery.description: How videos come back: poster image, ffmpeg keyframes, or signed links

include_raw.description: Also return the untouched actor record

tools.name: ads_register_gemini_key
tools.description: ⚠️ Uses your Gemini API key (paid quota / stored credentials). Register your Google Gemini API key so ads_analyze_video can describe and score ad videos for models that cannot watch video themselves. The key is checked against the Gemini API and then stored encrypted (AES-256-GCM), scoped to your account. Create one at aistudio.google.com/apikey. Use a paid-tier key for client creatives: Google may use free-tier inputs to improve its models. Videos are sent to Gemini for analysis, and larger ones are held in Google's Files API for up to 48 hours. Most users register the key on the server's /auth/connections page instead of calling this tool.

gemini_api_key.description: Gemini API key from Google AI Studio (current keys start with AQ.)

tools.name: ads_get_gemini_key_status
tools.description: Check whether a Gemini API key is available for the current user and where it comes from (encrypted per-user storage or the GEMINI_API_KEY environment fallback), and optionally verify it still works against the Gemini API.

verify.description: Also call the Gemini API to confirm the key still works

tools.name: ads_delete_gemini_key
tools.description: ⚠️ Uses your Gemini API key (paid quota / stored credentials). Delete the Gemini API key stored for the current user. Does not affect the GEMINI_API_KEY environment fallback, if one is configured, and does not revoke the key at Google.

tools.name: ads_list_tokens
tools.description: List Meta tokens registered for the current authenticated user (or the legacy global pool when running stdio / API key). Never exposes raw token values.

tools.name: ads_set_active_token
tools.description: ⚠️ Modifies live ads/account data. Switch the active Meta API token for the current user (or the legacy global pool when running stdio / API key).

bm_name.description: Name of the registered token / Business Manager to activate

tools.name: ads_register_token
tools.description: ⚠️ Modifies live ads/account data. Register a Meta access token (typically a System User token that does not expire) for the current authenticated user. Validates the token via GET /me before registering. In stdio / API-key mode, falls back to the in-memory legacy registry.

access_token.description: Meta API access token to register

tools.name: ads_delete_token
tools.description: ⚠️ Modifies live ads/account data. Delete a Meta token registered for the current authenticated user. No-op for the legacy in-memory pool.

bm_name.description: Name of the token to delete

review: Parent matched all captured names and pinned definition files to complete registered source, inspected extraction conversion and schemas, and reviewed scope/capability labels against implementations.
displayNotes: The full inventory includes 27 unrelated WhatsApp tools; they do not determine advertising groups.
